summary_en: Daifuku authorized acquisition of up to 6.6 million shares (1.77% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥40 billion via market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 to January 31, 2027, targeting improved capital efficiency and per-share value through share count reduction.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Provisions Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Daifuku's Board of Directors authorized a new share buyback program under the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 6.6 million shares of its own common stock, representing 1.77% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum aggregate purchase price of ¥40 billion. Purchases will be conducted via open market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 12, 2026 and January 31, 2027.

The stated objectives are to enhance capital efficiency, further expand shareholder returns, and increase per-share value through reduction of share count. The buyback may be partially or fully unexecuted depending on market conditions. As of October 31, 2026, Daifuku held 7.6 million treasury shares against 372.2 million issued shares excluding treasury stock.
